successCriteria.description: `src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts` exists and exports `ILeavePolicyService` interface with all 7 methods: `getById(id: string): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`, `getAll(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `getByLeaveType(leaveType: LeaveType): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `getActive(): Promise<LeavePolicy[]>`, `create(data: CreateLeavePolicyDto): Promise<LeavePolicy>`, `update(id: string, data: UpdateLeavePolicyDto): Promise<LeavePolicy | null>`, `deactivate(id: string): Promise<boolean>`

`src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts` exports `CreateLeavePolicyDto` with required fields `policyName`, `leaveType`, `entitlementDays` and optional fields `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, `minimumNoticeDays`, `requiresManagerApproval` — and does NOT include `isActive`, `id`, `createdAt`, or `updatedAt`

`src/modules/policy/policy.service.interface.ts` exports `UpdateLeavePolicyDto` as a `Partial<>` of all mutable `LeavePolicy` fields: `policyName`, `leaveType`, `entitlementDays`, `accrualRate`, `maxAccumulation`, `minimumNoticeDays`, `requiresManagerApproval`, `isActive` — and does NOT include `id`, `createdAt`, or `updatedAt`
`src/modules/policy/policy.service.ts` exports `LeavePolicyService` class that implements `ILeavePolicyService` and accepts `ILeavePolicyRepository` via constructor injection

`LeavePolicyService.create()` validates that `policyName` is a non-empty string, `leaveType` is a valid `LeaveType` enum member, and `entitlementDays` is a positive number — throwing a `ValidationError` (local class, same pattern as EmployeeService/AuditService) on failure; on success it sets `isActive: true` and delegates to `repository.create()`
`LeavePolicyService.update()` looks up the existing policy by id; returns `null` if not found; otherwise applies the partial `UpdateLeavePolicyDto` fields and delegates to `repository.update()`

`LeavePolicyService.deactivate()` looks up the existing policy by id; returns `false` if not found; returns `true` if already inactive; otherwise sets `isActive: false` and `updatedAt: new Date()`, delegates to `repository.update()`, and returns `true` if the update succeeded (result !== null)
`LeavePolicyService.getById()`, `getAll()`, `getByLeaveType()`, and `getActive()` are pure delegation methods that pass through to the corresponding repository method with no additional logic

constraints: The service interface file (`policy.service.interface.ts`) MUST import `LeavePolicy` from `./policy.model` and `LeaveType` from `src/shared/types/index.ts` — no other imports are permitted

The service implementation file (`policy.service.ts`) MUST import only from `./policy.model`, `./policy.repository`, `./policy.service.interface`, and `src/shared/types/index.ts` — no cross-module imports (e.g., no employee, audit, or balance module imports)
The `ValidationError` class used by `LeavePolicyService` MUST be defined locally in `policy.service.ts` (same pattern as `EmployeeService` and `AuditService`), not imported from another module
No `any` types anywhere — use `unknown` with type guards if needed (HARNESS.json constraint `no-any`)
No direct database access — all persistence goes through the injected `ILeavePolicyRepository` (GP-001)
outOfScope: Unit tests for the policy service — these are produced in Sub-phase 4.3 (Barrel export and unit tests)
Barrel export file (`src/modules/policy/index.ts`) — produced in Sub-phase 4.3

entityInvariants.invariant: A newly created LeavePolicy always has `isActive: true` — the service sets this, never the caller

A LeavePolicy's `isActive` can only transition ACTIVE→INACTIVE via `deactivate()` or an explicit `update()` with `isActive: false`; there is no dedicated "activate" method — reactivation goes through `update()` with `isActive: true`

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws ValidationError (locally defined) when required fields are missing/invalid: policyName empty/missing, leaveType not a valid LeaveType enum member, entitlementDays not a positive number
Returns `null` when the policy does not exist (caller distinguishes "not found" from "updated"); no error thrown for missing record
Returns `false` when the policy does not exist; returns `true` when already inactive (no-op); returns `true` on successful deactivation. Never throws.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: `LeavePolicyService` must follow the exact same structural pattern as `EmployeeService`: local `ValidationError` class, constructor-injected repository, `create()` validates required fields then sets active-state default before delegating, `update()` does find-then-apply, `deactivate()` does find-then-check-active-then-update with boolean return semantics
`ILeavePolicyService` interface + DTOs must follow the same co-location pattern as `IEmployeeService` + `CreateEmployeeDto` + `UpdateEmployeeDto` in a single `*.service.interface.ts` file

integrationPoints.why: Both service interface and implementation import `LeaveType` enum for method signatures and validation; this is the policy module's sole external dependency per the reconciled architecture dependency map
